bogleheadsPrinciples.title: Develop a Workable Plan
bogleheadsPrinciples.description: Base your financial plan on broad diversification, low costs, and disciplined regular investing. Determine an asset allocation that reflects your risk tolerance and holding horizon.

bogleheadsPrinciples.title: Invest with Simplicity: The 3-Fund UCITS Model
bogleheadsPrinciples.description: For European retail investors, simplicity outperforms complex active trading. The classic UCITS 3-Fund portfolio consists of: (1) Core World Equity (VWCE or IWDA+EIMI), (2) Small-Cap factor diversifier (IUSN), and (3) Global Aggregate Bonds (AGGU EUR Hedged).

bogleheadsPrinciples.title: Prioritize Accumulating (Acc) ETFs
bogleheadsPrinciples.description: Accumulating funds automatically reinvest dividends directly into the NAV. This prevents dividend cash drag, saves recurring broker reinvestment commissions, and eliminates taxable events in countries with favourable capital gains deferral.

bogleheadsPrinciples.title: Master Total Cost: TER + Tracking Difference
bogleheadsPrinciples.description: Do not look at TER alone! Tracking Difference (TD) measures how the fund actually performs relative to its index. Irish UCITS ETFs tracking US indices often show negative TD (-0.18%), outperforming the net benchmark due to the US-Ireland tax treaty.

bogleheadsPrinciples.title: Never Try to Time the Market
bogleheadsPrinciples.description: Curvo backtest data shows that missing the 10 best trading days over a 20-year period cuts total cumulative portfolio returns by more than 50%. Stay invested and use monthly automated Sparpläne (savings plans).

ireland.localWht: 0% Irish withholding tax for non-resident investors
ireland.usEstateTax: Exempt: Irish UCITS ETFs are not US-situs assets, shielding non-US residents from the 40% US Estate Tax on assets exceeding $60,000
ireland.verdict: The undisputed gold standard domicile for retail index investors worldwide.

luxembourg.usTreatyWithholding: 30% on certain asset classes unless specific sub-fund treaties apply
luxembourg.verdict: Strong for European bonds and STOXX Europe 600 (MEUD), but Ireland is preferred for US-heavy equity indices.

unitedStates.usTreatyWithholding: 30% standard WHT (reducible to 15% with W-8BEN depending on tax treaty)
unitedStates.usEstateTax: DANGEROUS: Up to 40% US Federal Estate Tax on all US assets exceeding $60,000 upon death for non-US citizens!
unitedStates.verdict: Strictly avoid holding US-domiciled ETFs as a non-US retail investor. Use Irish UCITS instead.

morningstarStyleBox.dimensions: Market Capitalization (Large, Mid, Small) x Investment Style (Value, Blend, Growth)
morningstarStyleBox.guide: Core portfolios (VWCE, IWDA, SXR8) occupy 'Large Blend', giving balanced exposure to all macro conditions. QDVE is 'Large Growth' (high valuation, momentum-driven). ZPRV is 'Small Value' (Fama-French factor premium).
